prompt:

Edit Image2 with two precise corrections: delete the final Japanese fullstop character 。 after the bottom explanation; tighten the outer image framing so only smallwhiteclearance surrounds the compact block. Verbatim complete visiblecopy, exactly3lines and NO extra punctuation: "利用できる空き容量" then "73.92 GB" then "オフライン保存に利用できる空き容量です". Keep current ordinary REGULAR typography:14px/24px title,12px/16px value and explanation, Meiryo400. Nativeblock390x80 with16px sideinsets, compact4px internalgaps, thinneutraldivider between value and explanation. Purewhite. No bold, icons, buttons, extra values or card. Preserve the present source-correct currentvalue and information anatomy. Do not increasepadding or add broad outerwhitefields.
reviewNotes: 補足末尾の余計な句点を除去、3行の文言・73.92GB・区切り線・無彩色を目視確認。原稿のRegular役割を保持する指定、正確なフォント同一性は未証明。検査用画布のピクセル寸法はアプリの余白や実装寸法ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
